title: Lunch Choices at Work · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: At my office, we have a small kitchen. Many people bring lunch from home. A few people buy food from the café next door. I am new here, so I watch and learn. On Monday, I bring rice and chicken. I see Anna has a big salad. She says, "I eat many vegetables every day." Tom has a sandwich. He says, "I don't have much time, so I make a quick lunch." I have a little fruit, too. On Tuesday, we talk about healthy food. Anna says, "You should eat a few nuts every day. They are good for you." Tom says, "You should not eat too much sugar. It is not good." I agree. I have a few cookies in my bag, but I don't eat them. On Wednesday, we have a team lunch. The café has many choices. I want a little soup and a few dumplings. Anna wants a big salad again.
prompt:
Part 1
What do you usually eat for lunch?
Do you bring lunch from home or buy it?
Do you like vegetables?
What is your favorite fruit?

Part 2
Describe a lunch you had at work or school. You should say:
- what you ate
- who you were with
- where you ate
- and explain why you liked or did not like it.

Part 3
Should people eat a big lunch or a small lunch? Why?
Is it good to eat many snacks?
What should schools do about healthy food?
Do you think people eat too much sugar? Why or why not?
